name: PagerDuty
description: Connect your own PagerDuty account to manage incident response from Imperal -- list/create/acknowledge/resolve/reassign/merge/snooze incidents, manage services and escalation policies, on-call schedules, users and teams, business services and service dependencies, tags and custom fields, event orchestration and incident workflows, automation actions, webhook subscriptions, and send/acknowledge/resolve alerts and change events via Events API v2. Uses your own REST API key and per-service Integration Keys -- nothing is hosted or proxied by Imperal beyond the request itself.

tools.name: connect_pagerduty
tools.description: Connect your own PagerDuty account by saving your REST API key, after checking it actually works. Get a key from PagerDuty: Integrations > Developer Tools > API Access Keys > Create New API Key.

api_key.description: Your PagerDuty REST API key (Integrations > Developer Tools > API Access Keys).
api_key.title: Api Key

from_email.description: Email of a PagerDuty user this key acts as for write requests requiring a From header (required by some endpoints, e.g. creating incidents).
from_email.title: From Email

label.description: Optional friendly name for this connection.
label.title: Label

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connected PagerDuty accounts and whether each saved REST API key still works.

params_schema.description: Explicit empty params model -- V17 disallows untyped handlers.
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: disconnect_pagerduty
tools.description: Disconnect a PagerDuty account: deletes the saved REST API key. Nothing in PagerDuty itself is changed; the account's own incidents, services, and configuration are untouched.

connection_id.description: Connection id to disconnect, from list_connections.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: save_integration_key
tools.description: Save a per-service Integration Key (routing key) used by Events API v2 and/or Change Events API. Find it on the service's Integrations tab in PagerDuty -- each integration (e.g. 'Events API v2') has its own key.

service_id.description: PagerDuty service id this integration key belongs to, from list_services.
service_id.title: Service Id

kind.description: Which surface this key routes to: 'events' (Events API v2 trigger/ack/resolve) or 'change' (Change Events API).
kind.title: Kind

integration_key.description: The 32-character Integration Key (routing_key) shown on the service's integration page.
integration_key.title: Integration Key

tools.name: list_integration_keys
tools.description: List saved per-service Integration Keys (routing keys) for Events API v2 / Change Events API. Keys themselves are never echoed back in full.

params_schema.description: Explicit empty params model -- V17 disallows untyped handlers.
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: delete_integration_key
tools.description: Permanently delete a saved Integration Key. Does not affect anything in PagerDuty itself -- only removes it from Imperal's storage.

key_id.description: Integration key id to remove, from list_integration_keys.
key_id.title: Key Id

tools.name: list_incidents
tools.description: List incidents in the connected PagerDuty account, optionally filtered by status, service, urgency, and date range.

statuses.description: Comma-separated statuses to filter by: triggered, acknowledged, resolved. Empty means all.
statuses.title: Statuses

service_ids.description: Comma-separated service ids to filter by. Empty means all services.
service_ids.title: Service Ids

urgency.description: Filter by urgency: 'high' or 'low'. Empty means both.
urgency.title: Urgency

since.description: ISO8601 start of date range, e.g. 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z.
since.title: Since

until.description: ISO8601 end of date range, e.g. 2026-08-21T00:00:00Z.
until.title: Until

tools.name: get_incident
tools.description: Read one incident in full: status, urgency, service, escalation policy, assignees, and its PagerDuty web URL.

tools.name: create_incident
tools.description: Create a new incident manually on a service (e.g. reporting a problem noticed outside of automated monitoring). Requires a From-email user on the connection.

service_id.description: Service this incident belongs to, from list_services.
service_id.title: Service Id

title.description: Short incident title, e.g. 'Checkout API returning 500s'.
title.title: Title

body_details.description: Longer free-text details describing the incident.
body_details.title: Body Details

escalation_policy_id.description: Optional escalation policy id to override the service default, from list_escalation_policies.
escalation_policy_id.title: Escalation Policy Id

tools.name: update_incident_status
tools.description: Change an incident's status: acknowledge, resolve, or reopen (set back to triggered).

tools.name: reassign_incident
tools.description: Reassign an incident to different users.

user_ids.description: Comma-separated PagerDuty user ids to assign, from list_users.
user_ids.title: User Ids

tools.name: update_incident_priority
tools.description: Set or clear an incident's priority level.

priority_id.description: Priority id to set, from list_priorities. Empty clears the priority.
priority_id.title: Priority Id

tools.name: merge_incidents
tools.description: Merge one or more source incidents into a target incident. Source incidents are closed and their alerts move to the target.

target_incident_id.description: Incident id that survives the merge, from list_incidents.
target_incident_id.title: Target Incident Id

source_incident_ids.description: Comma-separated incident ids to merge into the target.
source_incident_ids.title: Source Incident Ids

tools.name: snooze_incident
tools.description: Snooze an incident for N seconds -- it stops notifying and reopens automatically if not resolved by then.

duration_seconds.description: How long to snooze re-notification for, in seconds.
duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds

tools.name: add_incident_note
tools.description: Add a note to an incident -- visible to everyone with access to it.

content.description: Note text to add to the incident.
content.title: Content

tools.name: list_incident_notes
tools.description: Read the notes left on an incident.

tools.name: list_incident_alerts
tools.description: List the individual alerts grouped into one incident.

tools.name: list_incident_log_entries
tools.description: Read the full activity timeline of an incident -- every trigger, acknowledge, escalate, reassign, resolve and note event, in order.

tools.name: run_response_play
tools.description: Run a saved Response Play against an incident -- executes its predefined set of actions (notify responders, run status update, etc.).

response_play_id.description: Response play id to run, from list_response_plays.
response_play_id.title: Response Play Id

tools.name: bulk_incident_action
tools.description: Acknowledge or resolve several incidents in one call, by explicit incident ids. Continues past per-item failures and reports each result.

incident_ids.description: Comma-separated incident ids to act on, from list_incidents.
incident_ids.title: Incident Ids

status.description: New status to apply to all: 'acknowledged' or 'resolved'.
status.title: Status

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List services (the things that receive alerts and generate incidents) in the connected PagerDuty account, optionally filtered by name.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Read one PagerDuty service in full: its status, escalation policy, and description.

tools.name: create_service
tools.description: Create a new PagerDuty service (a monitored system/component that generates incidents), attached to an escalation policy.

escalation_policy_id.description: Escalation policy id this service uses, from list_escalation_policies.
escalation_policy_id.title: Escalation Policy Id

description.description: Optional description of what this service represents.
description.title: Description

tools.name: update_service
tools.description: Update an existing service's name and/or escalation policy. Only given fields change.

name.description: New service name. Leave empty to keep current.
name.title: Name

description.description: New description. Leave empty to keep current.
description.title: Description

escalation_policy_id.description: New escalation policy id. Leave empty to keep current.
escalation_policy_id.title: Escalation Policy Id

tools.name: delete_service
tools.description: Permanently delete a PagerDuty service. Cannot be undone -- incidents tied to it remain but the service configuration is gone.

service_id.description: Service id to permanently delete, from list_services.
service_id.title: Service Id

tools.name: list_service_integrations
tools.description: List the integrations (event sources / Integration Keys) configured on one service -- each one's own routing_key powers Events API v2 and Change Events API calls for that specific integration.

tools.name: create_service_integration
tools.description: Add a new integration to a service (e.g. a generic Events API integration, or a specific vendor like Datadog/Prometheus). Returns an Integration Key you can save via save_integration_key for Events API v2 / Change Events API calls.

vendor_id.description: Optional PagerDuty vendor id for a known integration type (e.g. Datadog's vendor id). Leave empty for a generic Events API v2 integration.
vendor_id.title: Vendor Id

tools.name: delete_service_integration
tools.description: Permanently remove an integration from a service. Any external system still using its old integration key will stop being able to send alerts.

integration_id.description: Integration id to remove, from list_service_integrations.
integration_id.title: Integration Id

tools.name: list_escalation_policies
tools.description: List escalation policies (who gets notified, in what order, and how fast it escalates) in the connected PagerDuty account.

query.description: Filter escalation policies by name substring.
query.title: Query

tools.name: get_escalation_policy
tools.description: Read one escalation policy in full, including its rule count and loop/handoff settings.

tools.name: create_escalation_policy
tools.description: Create a new escalation policy with a single rule targeting one or more users, with a configurable escalation delay and repeat count.

user_ids_level_1.description: Comma-separated user ids for the first escalation level, from list_users.
user_ids_level_1.title: User Ids Level 1

escalation_delay_minutes.description: Minutes to wait before escalating to the next level if unacknowledged.
escalation_delay_minutes.title: Escalation Delay Minutes

num_loops.description: How many times to repeat the escalation rules if nobody acknowledges.
num_loops.title: Num Loops

tools.name: update_escalation_policy
tools.description: Update an escalation policy's name and/or repeat-loop count. Only given fields change.

name.description: New name. Leave empty to keep current.
name.title: Name

num_loops.description: New loop count. 0 leaves current value unchanged.
num_loops.title: Num Loops

tools.name: delete_escalation_policy
tools.description: Permanently delete an escalation policy. Fails if any service still references it -- reassign those services to another policy first.

escalation_policy_id.description: Escalation policy id to permanently delete, from list_escalation_policies.
escalation_policy_id.title: Escalation Policy Id

tools.name: list_schedules
tools.description: List on-call schedules (rotations) configured in the connected PagerDuty account, optionally filtered by name.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Read one on-call schedule in full, including its current rotation users and time zone.

since.description: ISO8601 start of the window to render, e.g. 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z.
since.title: Since

until.description: ISO8601 end of the window to render, e.g. 2026-08-31T00:00:00Z.
until.title: Until

tools.name: create_schedule
tools.description: Create a new on-call rotation schedule with one layer of users rotating on a fixed interval (daily or weekly).

user_ids.description: Comma-separated user ids in rotation order, from list_users.
user_ids.title: User Ids

rotation_turn_length_seconds.description: Length of each rotation turn in seconds. Default 604800 = 1 week.
rotation_turn_length_seconds.title: Rotation Turn Length Seconds

rotation_start.description: ISO8601 start of the first rotation turn, e.g. 2026-08-01T09:00:00Z.
rotation_start.title: Rotation Start

tools.name: delete_schedule
tools.description: Permanently delete an on-call schedule. Fails if an escalation policy still references it.

schedule_id.description: Schedule id to permanently delete, from list_schedules.
schedule_id.title: Schedule Id

tools.name: create_schedule_override
tools.description: Create a one-off override on a schedule -- e.g. swap who's on call for vacation coverage, without changing the underlying rotation.

user_id.description: User id to cover this override slot, from list_users.
user_id.title: User Id

start.description: ISO8601 start of the override, e.g. 2026-08-22T00:00:00Z.
start.title: Start

end.description: ISO8601 end of the override, e.g. 2026-08-23T00:00:00Z.
end.title: End

tools.name: delete_schedule_override
tools.description: Remove a schedule override, reverting to the underlying rotation for that time window.

tools.name: list_oncalls
tools.description: List who is currently on call (or will be), optionally filtered by schedule ids or escalation policy ids, within a time window.

schedule_ids.description: Comma-separated schedule ids to filter by. Empty means all.
schedule_ids.title: Schedule Ids

escalation_policy_ids.description: Comma-separated escalation policy ids to filter by. Empty means all.
escalation_policy_ids.title: Escalation Policy Ids

user_ids.description: Comma-separated user ids to filter by. Empty means all.
user_ids.title: User Ids

tools.name: list_pd_users
tools.description: List users registered in the connected PagerDuty account, optionally filtered by name/email substring or team ids.

team_ids.description: Comma-separated team ids to filter by. Empty means all teams.
team_ids.title: Team Ids

tools.name: get_pd_user
tools.description: Read one PagerDuty user's profile in full.

tools.name: create_pd_user
tools.description: Create a new user in the connected PagerDuty account and send them an invite email.

name.description: Full name of the new user.
name.title: Name

email.description: Email address of the new user -- PagerDuty sends them an invite.
email.title: Email

role.description: Role to assign: owner, admin, manager, responder, observer, stakeholder, limited_stakeholder, restricted_access, read_only_user, or user.
role.title: Role

tools.name: update_pd_user
tools.description: Update an existing PagerDuty user's name and/or role. Only given fields change.

name.description: New name. Leave empty to keep current.
name.title: Name

role.description: New role. Leave empty to keep current.
role.title: Role

tools.name: delete_pd_user
tools.description: Permanently remove a user from the connected PagerDuty account. They are also removed from any schedules/escalation policies referencing them.

user_id.description: User id to permanently remove, from list_pd_users.
user_id.title: User Id

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: List teams defined in the connected PagerDuty account, optionally filtered by name substring.

tools.name: create_team
tools.description: Create a new team to group users, services, and escalation policies.

description.description: Optional description of the team's purpose.
description.title: Description

tools.name: delete_team
tools.description: Permanently delete a team. Members, services, and policies keep existing -- they simply lose this team association.

team_id.description: Team id to permanently delete, from list_teams.
team_id.title: Team Id

tools.name: add_user_to_team
tools.description: Add a user to a team with a given role (manager or member).

user_id.description: User id to add, from list_pd_users.
user_id.title: User Id

role.description: Team role for this user: 'manager' or 'responder'.
role.title: Role

tools.name: remove_user_from_team
tools.description: Remove a user from a team.

user_id.description: User id to remove, from list_pd_users.
user_id.title: User Id

tools.name: list_business_services
tools.description: List business services -- the non-technical capabilities (e.g. 'Online Checkout') that group technical services for stakeholder-facing status.

query.description: Filter business services by name substring.
query.title: Query

tools.name: create_business_service
tools.description: Create a new business service -- a non-technical capability stakeholders can watch, made up of one or more technical services underneath it.

description.description: What this business capability represents to non-technical stakeholders.
description.title: Description

point_of_contact.description: Free-text name/contact for who owns this business service.
point_of_contact.title: Point Of Contact

tools.name: update_business_service
tools.description: Update an existing business service's name and/or description.

name.description: New name. Leave empty to keep current.
name.title: Name

description.description: New description. Leave empty to keep current.
description.title: Description

tools.name: delete_business_service
tools.description: Permanently delete a business service. Cannot be undone.

business_service_id.description: Business service id to permanently delete, from list_business_services.
business_service_id.title: Business Service Id

tools.name: list_service_dependencies
tools.description: List the technical-service dependencies mapped to one business service -- which underlying services feed its status.

tools.name: add_service_dependency
tools.description: Map a technical service as a dependency of a business service, so the business service's health reflects that underlying service's incidents.

technical_service_id.description: Technical (regular) service id that supports it, from list_services.
technical_service_id.title: Technical Service Id

tools.name: remove_service_dependency
tools.description: Remove a technical service's dependency mapping from a business service.

dependency_id.description: Dependency id to remove, from list_service_dependencies.
dependency_id.title: Dependency Id

tools.name: list_priorities
tools.description: List the priority levels (P1-P5 style) configured on the connected PagerDuty account -- used to set/change an incident's priority.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List tags defined in the connected PagerDuty account -- labels attachable to users, teams, escalation policies, or services.

tools.name: create_tag
tools.description: Create a new tag on the connected PagerDuty account.

tools.name: delete_tag
tools.description: Permanently delete a tag from the account -- removes it from every resource it was attached to.

tag_id.description: Tag id to permanently delete, from list_tags.
tag_id.title: Tag Id

tools.name: assign_tag
tools.description: Attach an existing tag to a user, team, escalation policy, or service.

entity_type.description: Type of the entity to tag: 'users', 'teams', 'escalation_policies', or 'services'.
entity_type.title: Entity Type

entity_id.description: Id of the entity to attach the tag to.
entity_id.title: Entity Id

tools.name: remove_tag_assignment
tools.description: Detach a tag from a user, team, escalation policy, or service.

entity_type.description: Type of the entity to untag: 'users', 'teams', 'escalation_policies', or 'services'.
entity_type.title: Entity Type

entity_id.description: Id of the entity to remove the tag from.
entity_id.title: Entity Id

tools.name: list_custom_fields
tools.description: List custom incident fields configured on the connected PagerDuty account -- structured metadata attachable to incidents.

tools.name: create_custom_field
tools.description: Create a new custom incident field on the connected PagerDuty account.

name.description: Internal machine name for the field, e.g. 'affected_region'.
name.title: Name

display_name.description: Human-readable label shown on incidents, e.g. 'Affected Region'.
display_name.title: Display Name

data_type.description: Field data type: string, integer, float, boolean, url, or datetime.
data_type.title: Data Type

tools.name: delete_custom_field
tools.description: Permanently delete a custom incident field. Cannot be undone.

field_id.description: Custom field id to permanently delete, from list_custom_fields.
field_id.title: Field Id

tools.name: set_incident_custom_field
tools.description: Set a custom field's value on one specific incident.

value.description: Value to set on this incident for the field.
value.title: Value

tools.name: list_event_orchestrations
tools.description: List event orchestrations -- the rule sets that decide which service (and with what enrichment) an incoming event turns into an incident.

tools.name: create_event_orchestration
tools.description: Create a new event orchestration -- a rule-based router that decides which service an incoming event becomes an incident on.

team_id.description: Optional team id that owns this orchestration, from list_teams.
team_id.title: Team Id

tools.name: get_event_orchestration
tools.description: Read one event orchestration in full.

tools.name: delete_event_orchestration
tools.description: Permanently delete an event orchestration. Cannot be undone.

orchestration_id.description: Orchestration id to permanently delete, from list_event_orchestrations.
orchestration_id.title: Orchestration Id

tools.name: get_event_orchestration_router
tools.description: Read one event orchestration's router rules -- the conditions that decide which service an event is routed to.

tools.name: list_incident_workflows
tools.description: List incident workflows -- reusable multi-step automated response sequences (e.g. notify + create Slack channel + run a script).

tools.name: get_incident_workflow
tools.description: Read one incident workflow in full.

tools.name: run_incident_workflow
tools.description: Manually trigger an incident workflow to run against a specific incident right now.

workflow_id.description: Incident workflow id to trigger manually, from list_incident_workflows.
workflow_id.title: Workflow Id

incident_id.description: Incident id this workflow instance runs against, from list_incidents.
incident_id.title: Incident Id

tools.name: list_incident_workflow_triggers
tools.description: List incident workflow triggers -- what automatically starts a workflow (e.g. incident created on a given service).

tools.name: list_automation_actions
tools.description: List automation actions (runbook automation) configured in the connected PagerDuty account -- scripts/actions that can be invoked directly from an incident.

tools.name: get_automation_action
tools.description: Read one automation action in full.

tools.name: invoke_automation_action_on_incident
tools.description: Invoke a runbook automation action directly against a specific incident.

incident_id.description: Incident id to run the action against, from list_incidents.
incident_id.title: Incident Id

action_id.description: Automation action id to invoke, from list_automation_actions.
action_id.title: Action Id

tools.name: list_automation_runners
tools.description: List automation runners -- the registered execution environments (Runbook Automation Runner / Process Automation) that carry out automation actions.

tools.name: list_webhook_subscriptions
tools.description: List webhook subscriptions (Webhooks v3) configured on the connected PagerDuty account -- which events push notifications to which URL.

tools.name: create_webhook_subscription
tools.description: Subscribe to PagerDuty events (e.g. incident.triggered, incident.acknowledged, incident.resolved) so PagerDuty POSTs them to your URL as they happen.

delivery_url.description: Your own HTTPS endpoint PagerDuty will POST events to.
delivery_url.title: Delivery Url

description.description: Short description of what this webhook is for.
description.title: Description

events.description: Comma-separated event types to subscribe to, e.g. incident.triggered, incident.acknowledged, incident.resolved, incident.escalated, incident.reassigned.
events.title: Events

filter_type.description: Scope of the subscription: 'account_reference' (whole account) or 'service_reference' (one service).
filter_type.title: Filter Type

filter_id.description: Service id to scope to, required only when filter_type is 'service_reference'.
filter_id.title: Filter Id

tools.name: get_webhook_subscription
tools.description: Read one webhook subscription's full configuration.

tools.name: update_webhook_subscription
tools.description: Change a webhook subscription's URL, event list, and/or active state.

delivery_url.description: New delivery URL. Leave empty to keep current.
delivery_url.title: Delivery Url

active.description: Whether the webhook subscription is active.
active.title: Active

tools.name: delete_webhook_subscription
tools.description: Permanently remove a webhook subscription. Cannot be undone.

webhook_id.description: Webhook subscription id to permanently delete, from list_webhook_subscriptions.
webhook_id.title: Webhook Id

tools.name: ping_webhook_subscription
tools.description: Send a test ping event to a webhook subscription so you can confirm your endpoint receives it.

webhook_id.description: Webhook subscription id to send a test ping to, from list_webhook_subscriptions.
webhook_id.title: Webhook Id

tools.name: trigger_event
tools.description: Send a new alert into PagerDuty via Events API v2 -- creates (or adds to) an incident on the service tied to the given integration key. Provide either integration_key_id (from list_integration_keys) or a raw routing_key directly.

integration_key_id.description: Saved integration key id, from list_integration_keys. Leave empty if passing routing_key directly.
integration_key_id.title: Integration Key Id

routing_key.description: The Service Integration's Events API v2 routing/integration key (used only if integration_key_id is empty).
routing_key.title: Routing Key

summary.description: Short human-readable alert summary, e.g. 'Disk usage above 90% on prod-db-1'.
summary.title: Summary

source.description: What system detected this, e.g. 'monitoring-service' or a hostname.
source.title: Source

severity.description: Alert severity: critical, error, warning, or info.
severity.title: Severity

dedup_key.description: Optional key to group related events into one alert. Leave empty to auto-generate.
dedup_key.title: Dedup Key

custom_details.description: Optional JSON string of extra key/value context to attach to the alert.
custom_details.title: Custom Details

tools.name: ack_or_resolve_event
tools.description: Acknowledge or resolve an existing alert via Events API v2, using the dedup_key returned by trigger_event (or your own external key).

integration_key_id.description: Saved integration key id, from list_integration_keys. Leave empty if passing routing_key directly.
integration_key_id.title: Integration Key Id

routing_key.description: The Service Integration's Events API v2 routing/integration key (used only if integration_key_id is empty).

dedup_key.description: The dedup_key of the alert to acknowledge or resolve, from the original trigger response.
dedup_key.title: Dedup Key

tools.name: send_change_event
tools.description: Send a change event (e.g. a deploy) to PagerDuty's Change Events API -- tracked alongside incidents for correlation, without creating an incident itself. Provide either integration_key_id or a raw routing_key.

routing_key.description: The Service Integration's Change Events API routing/integration key (used only if integration_key_id is empty).

summary.description: Short description of the change, e.g. 'Deployed checkout-service v2.14.0'.

source.description: What system triggered this change, e.g. 'ci-cd-pipeline'.
source.title: Source

custom_details.description: Optional JSON string of extra key/value context (commit sha, PR link, etc.).
custom_details.title: Custom Details

link_url.description: Optional URL linking to more details (e.g. the deploy pipeline run).
link_url.title: Link Url

link_text.description: Label for link_url. Defaults to 'Details' if left empty.

until.description: ISO8601 end of the analytics window, e.g. 2026-08-21T00:00:00Z.
until.title: Until

service_ids.description: Comma-separated service ids to filter by. Empty means all services.

tools.name: list_audit_records
tools.description: List audit trail records -- PagerDuty's own log of who changed what configuration and when, optionally filtered by date range and action type.

since.description: ISO8601 start of the audit window, e.g. 2026-08-14T00:00:00Z.

tools.name: audit_account
tools.description: Value-add report: build one aggregated health snapshot across every service in the connected PagerDuty account -- open incident counts, escalation policy coverage, services with no integrations configured (silent services that can never receive alerts), and disabled services.

secrets.name: pagerduty_connections
secrets.description: Your connected PagerDuty accounts -- stored as a JSON array, one entry per account, each with its own REST API key. Managed through connect_pagerduty / disconnect_pagerduty -- you should not need to edit this directly.

secrets.name: pagerduty_integration_keys
secrets.description: Your saved per-service Integration Keys (routing keys) for Events API v2 / Change Events API -- stored as a JSON array. Managed through save_integration_key / delete_integration_key.

pricing.notes: Fixed platform scale {0,8,16,20,40,60} per canonical PRICING_POLICY.md. Not a Google-backed app, no x1.8 markup. connect/disconnect/list_connections/integration-key management (local secret store, no external API cost) are free; single-entity CRUD=16; read=8; event-send/response-play/workflow-run/merge (real-time production actions)=20; aggregated account audit=40; bulk incident action=60.
